segments.text: Protagonist of the heaven route and master of the heaven type guardian Ten-Chan. A cheerful, but airheaded girl. She awakens to her guardian abilities during an attack on her school by Egubado and from that moment onward fights to protect what is dear to her.

Protagonist of the earth route and master of the earth type guardian Pochi. A biker with a strong sense of justice traveling throughout Japan. She awakens to her guardian after the hotel she was staying at was attacked and resolves to fight against Egubado ever since.
Joins in the heaven route. Miyuki's best friend and the master of the fire type guardian Kouen. Often finds herself exasperated at Miyuki's antics but supports her nonetheless.

Joins in the heaven route. Master of the water type guardian Mel. Seeks revenge against Egubado for their involvement in the murder of her father and disappearance of her childhood friend. Becomes especially close with Keiko.
and becomes family her her during the epilogue.

Joins in the heaven route. Master of the wind type guardian Nagi. Has the ability to unconsciously read minds and had a troubled childhood because of it. Forms a very close bond with Misato throughout the course of the game.
And becomes family her her during the epilogue.

Joins in the earth route. Master of the holy type guardian Nolt. Former member of the JSDF and the team brains. Logical to a fault and is capable of making difficult decisions if it's for the good of the group. She often butts heads with Yuuko due to their contrasting personalities, but cares for her deeply despite that.

Joins in the earth route. Master of the lighting type guardian Zabitan. Tokusatsu otaku and rock singer of justice. A tokusatsu maniac to the point where she can't help but act like a hero of justice and never fails to have a dramatic speech ready. Fights against Egubado to be just like the heroes she admires.
Optional boss character and a unlockable character in the PSX version. Master of the heaven type guardian Gohoudouji. A warrior that seeks to challenge the strong.

Joins in the heaven route. Master of the earth type guardian Gaou. She was fighting against Egubado before the game's start an recruits Miyuki open learning of her abilities. Plays the role of the team's big sis.

Joins in the heaven route. Master of the lighting type guardian Zekuu. Raised in the same orphanage as Kaoru and is her best friend, but is separated from her at the game's start when she captured by Egubado.
Joins in the heaven route. Master of the holy type guardian Dogar. The more cheerful and outgoing of the Ichinomiya twins. Her powers don't work unless she is with her sister.

Joins in the earth route. Master of the dark type guardian Kanetsugu. Was Yukari's mentor on how to use a guardian. She allows herself to get captured at the start of the game in order to allow Yui to escape during one of Egubado's attacks.
Joins in the earth route. Master of the holy type guardian Saiki. A descendant of a long line of protectors. Joins Yuuko's team in order to save Naoe.
Joins in the earth route. Master of the water type guardian Archer. Akira's number one fan, a airheaded lady that goes at her own pace much to the chagrin of those around her.
Joins in the earth route. Master of the wind type guardian Fudou. Was raised in the same orphanage as her best friend Ran. After Ran is kidnapped she joins Yuuko's group to find her.
Joins in the earth route. Master of the lighting type guardian Kirara. Boy crazy, but her luck with men is horrible due to Egubado's attacks interfering with all of her dates.
Has the reputation of being the only character with a straight sex scene in a otherwise yuri game.
Joins in the heaven route. Master of the fire type guardian Gara. The more shy and reserved of the Ichinomiya sisters. Her powers don't work unless she is with her sister.
A member of Egubado. Master of the dark type guardian Kokuryuu. Has a long history with her superior Megumi. Has a negative outlook on life.
But after a meeting with Miyuki she begins to have hope for the future and eventually betrays Egubado. Joins after Miyuki's and Yuuko's group meet each other.
Tomomi's subordinate and a villain in the heaven route. Master of the water type guardian Wool.
Misato's childhood friend. Was unintentionally responsible for the deaths of her parents and Misato's father. Was taken in by Egubado shortly after.
Villain in the earth route. Master of the heaven type guardian Donald. Trouble making member of Egubado that constantly gets in Yuuko's way with schemes that always blow up in her face.
A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the fire type guardian Suzaku. She has a fondness towards cute girls, but is a sadistic women who only sees them as playthings for her to monopolize.
A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the earth type guardian Genbu. A cold blooded and calculating woman. Is especially fond of her subordinate and long time friend Jin.
After Jin's betrayal she loses her calm personality as she becomes obsessed with getting revenge.
A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the lighting type guardian Byakko. A vain woman who thinks nothing of others and is only concerned with her own appearance.
A member of the Shimonshou. Master of the water type guardian Seiryuu. Has hidden feelings for Megumi and a deep resentment towards Jin for her relationship with her.
Egubado's leader. A woman shrouded in mystery.
